newsitem.title: USA: Keystone Financial files shelf for $400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Keystone Financial files shelf for $400 mln.

text.p: Keystone Mid-Atlantic Funding Corp, a unit of Harrisburg-Pa.-based Keystone Financial Inc, filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering for up to $400 million in senior subordinated medium-term notes.
The notes, to be underwritten by Goldman Sachs & Co, Bear Stearns & Co Inc and Keefe Bruyette & Woods Inc, are guaranteed by Keystone Financial.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repaying outstanding debt, according to the SEC filing.
